note: How big a project's merged items are (goal an-item-is-a-change-a-reviewer-reads-in-ten-minutes): medianLinesPerItem is the median lines_changed (the merged pull request's additions plus deletions) over its merged items that changed any, an even count the mean of the middle two rounded down; itemsCounted is how many those are. A merge whose size was never read (0 lines, or one recorded before the count) is in neither. Both are 0 while nothing has counted. Here four merged items changed 100, 300, 500 and 0 lines: 300 over 3.
